01-manulife-office.jpg.en: Four months of policy clauses, premium tables and cold outreach. Those letters on the table spell MDRT — for now my contribution is mostly standing near them and hoping it is contagious.
01-manulife-office.jpg.zh: 四个月的保单条款、费率表和陌生拜访。桌上那几个字母拼出来是 MDRT——现阶段我的贡献主要是站在它旁边，指望能沾上点运气。

02-mentor.jpg.en: With my mentor at Manulife. A warm and remarkably patient agent, she taught me both the technical side of insurance and how a conversation with a client actually goes.
02-mentor.jpg.zh: 与我在宏利的带教。一位非常热情、极有耐心的销售，保险的专业知识和与客户沟通的实际打法，大半都是她教我的。

03-licence.jpg.en: Licensed at last: the agent card, issued November 2025, after passing the Hong Kong insurance intermediary qualifying examinations. Agent and branch numbers are redacted.
03-licence.jpg.zh: 终于持牌了：代理人证于 2025 年 11 月签发，此前通过香港保险中介人资格考试。代理人编号与分行编号已遮去。
